Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On April 8, 2002: The Space Shuttle Atlantis is launched on mission STS-110, carrying the S0 truss to the International Space Station. Astronaut Jerry L. Ross also becomes the first person to fly on seven spaceflights.
On April 8, 1886: William Ewart Gladstone introduces the first Irish Home Rule Bill into the British House of Commons.
On April 8, 1730: Shearith Israel, the first synagogue in continental North America, is dedicated.
April 8 is observed as Earliest day on which Fast and Prayer Day can fall, while April 14 is the latest; celebrated on the second Friday in April (Liberia).
April 8 is observed as International Romani Day.
